Class LuaScript

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.lua.LuaScript
public class LuaScript extends Object
Database model of a MeshApp Lua script.

Stores a stable GUID, emoji icon, source code, user enablement settings, and last-run metadata shown by the MeshApp IDE script list.
